# Cully v0.4.1

Use `cully setup --agent codex`, `cully setup --agent claude` or `cully setup --agent cursor` to set up Cully's local stack and connect the selected coding agent. The earlier positional form still works for existing scripts.

Setup creates reusable private credentials, starts PostgreSQL, Mem0, the private data API and Cully MCP, registers the MCP connection, refreshes the Cully skill and session hooks, and starts the local advisor daemon when needed. The quickstart and website now explain that full setup flow.

The personal deployment workflow now uses the existing Kubernetes Secret reference in Cully's MCP metadata. It no longer tries to inject a duplicate plaintext token into the manifest.
